messages:
jade: Heads-up — noticed a TP all-reduce perf regression on the 8xA100 nightly run. 1.5x slowdown on forward when pipeline micro-batches are <=4. Repro: run tp_small_mb test with kvcache enabled.

rafi: ugh, saw something similar earlier. Any flamegraphs? kernel_selector logs?

jade: Pasted the quick profile from last night:
```
allreduce_op: avg=12.4ms p95=28.7ms (old) -> avg=18.6ms p95=49.1ms (regressed)
comm/compute overlap dropped from ~35% to ~8% on stage 2
kvcache flushes spiked at micro-batch boundaries
```
Link to perf bot result: https://perf.internal/3399001111 (perf-bot posted)

perf-bot: Automatic diff: allreduce latency regression detected in tp_small_mb - diff +6.2ms avg, +20.4ms p95. Attached NVPROF + kernel selection logs.

maria: Looking at kernel_selector.log: recent change bumped tree fallback priority for small fragments: rule 'prefer_tree_on_fragments' was flipped in commit d4c2. That would increase extra handshakes for small messages.

ciara: That matches KV cache behavior — when kvcache returns hits we get lots of tiny key-value packets (sub-4KB) aggregated into independent allreduce calls. Tree has higher setup cost for many tiny msgs vs ring streaming.

jade: Re-ran with manual override to force ring for allreduce: perf back to baseline (avg ~12.6ms). So kernel choice is the primary culprit when messages are fragmented. But there are also scheduling knobs that make it worse (in-flight window limit + eager flush).

rafi: Could be two orthogonal issues: 1) kernel selection heuristic misclassifies fragmented payloads, 2) the batching heuristic triggers flushes at stage boundaries. Proposed short-term fix: add a rule to prefer ring when avg_msg_size < 16KB AND num_fragments > 8.

maria: Agree. Also we should consider a coalescing layer in the TP per-stage queue: when kvcache hit rate > 60% and micro-batch <=4, allow lightweight coalesce for 1-2ms to form larger messages. That preserves latency for normal cases but avoids the tiny-msg pathological path.

ciara: Small concern: coalescing can increase jitter for ultra-low-latency customers. Make it opt-in by default and enable in internal nightly. Add metrics: coalesced_bytes, coalesce_delay_ms, impacted_p99.

jade: Quick sketch of new heuristic (pseudo):
```
if stage_count > 1 and micro_mb <=4 and kvcache_hit_rate >= 0.6:
  enable_coalesce(timeout_ms=2, max_bytes=64KB)
else:
  disable_coalesce()

# kernel switch
if avg_fragment_size < 16KB and fragments > 8:
  prefer_kernel('ring')
else:
  rely_on_selector()
```

rafi: Sounds solid. Two experiments: A) kernel-rule-only, B) kernel-rule + coalesce(2ms). We'll run both across 8/16 GPU shapes. Can someone own infra jobs?

maria: I'll run A and B on nightly infra, start with 8xA100 and 16xA100. Expect baseline metrics in ~2hrs.

ciara: I'll add instrumentation to runtime: emit event when we fall back to tree vs ring, and log fragment histograms per-stage. Also expose a short tracing tag so we can correlate with KV cache events.

jade: Owner notes: maria -> run experiments; ciara -> add traces/metrics; rafi -> land quick kernel-selector rule change (feature-flagged). I'll draft the PR with config and the perf numbers to justify revert of d4c2 if needed.

perf-bot: New experiment jobs enqueued: exp/3399001111/A (kernel-rule-only), exp/3399001111/B (kernel+coalesce). Will post diffs when complete. :white_check_mark:

jade: Thanks all — goal is to have a safe toggle by tomorrow morning. If A fixes >90% of regression we can ship kernel-rule quickfix and iterate on coalesce next week.

rafi: Also add a note to release notes: 'TP allreduce: improved small-message kernel heuristics, optional coalescing for kvcache-heavy workloads'.

maria: Will attach CSV of results once jobs finish.

ciara: Filed follow-up issue: #INF-1127 to explore auto-tuning thresholds using stage-level microbenchmarks (perf/auto-tune).

jade: Closing loop: leave thread open for perf-bot results. Thanks! :rocket:
